authority_note: Minimal narrative policy record for values that cannot be derived mechanically from the controlling registers. Everything that can be derived is derived. This record creates no state: it does not open or close a gate, does not close a work package, does not record a disposition, and does not authorize anything.

gate.name: Gate A

unauthorized_stages.statement: WP-039 is not authorized. No record in this repository authorizes it.

Execution of the TTR-001 verification protocol is deferred by DEC-022 and is not authorized now. The partial runner under scripts/accessibility/ is dormant development tooling; it measured nothing and produced no audit evidence. No Cycle 9 is authorized either.
No route, component, or control has been measured or classified against TTR-001, so the interface is unmeasured rather than passing. FND-024 stays open as deferred debt.

Implementation or assessment of the disposed requirement candidates is not authorized. The seven candidates adopted under DEC-020 remain candidates that are not assessed and not implemented, HREQ-025 remains NEEDS-EVIDENCE / DEFER and is not rewritten, and no accessibility conformance is claimed for any of them.

The runtime trust spine remains plan-only. No backend, authentication, database, server-side storage, tenancy, artificial intelligence, or real personal data is authorized. Product Alpha 001, authorized by DEC-023, is a local-only synthetic slice held in one browser and does not implement, start, or imply any part of the runtime trust spine.
Promotion of PKG-002 to canonical is not authorized. It remains a synchronized reference.
Resolution of the recorded package drift rows is not authorized. Each remains unresolved.

Work beyond the authorized Product Alpha 001 slice is not authorized. The slice covers fictional learners, one goal at a time, observations, support actions, results, and the deterministic LLR-001 next step, held in browser-local storage. Accounts, sharing, reporting, export to district systems, artificial-intelligence features, and any real personal data are outside it. A bounded PRODUCT-ALPHA-001-EXPANSION stage remains unauthorized: no expansion beyond this exact local synthetic proof is authorized, no new work package is opened for it, and it is not a WP-007 cycle.

publication_boundary: PUBLIC SYNTHETIC PROTOTYPE. NO REAL PERSONAL DATA. NOT RELEASED. The published application URL is reachable by anyone who has the link; the interface is not access-controlled, and the private setting of the Lovable project does not restrict the published surface. The robots file asks search engines not to index it, which is a crawler request and not access control. Hosting this application does not constitute release authority, and no production use, district deployment, independent validation, certification, or compliance-conformance claim is authorized or made. Making the deployment private or unpublishing it is a manual owner action recorded in docs/PUBLICATION_ACCESS.md.

next_defensible_owner_action.action: Perform a bounded founder/operator walkthrough of Product Alpha 001 and record usability findings; then decide whether the workflow needs a bounded revision or is stable enough for a separately authorized TTR-001 audit.
next_defensible_owner_action.why: The Product Alpha 001 slice authorized by DEC-023 is implemented and mechanically tested. Technical tests establish mechanics only: they do not establish usefulness, workflow stability, learning impact, educational validity, accessibility conformance, privacy or security certification, or any human validation. Only a founder/operator walkthrough can produce that observation, and only a separate owner decision can authorize the deferred TTR-001 audit — nothing here authorizes it. FND-024 stays open as deferred debt until an owner decision either authorizes execution or records that it stays unrun.

deferred_debt.statement: The touch-target acceptance rule TTR-001 is defined but has never been executed against the interface. The obligation is deferred, not discharged.
